method: Primary agent physically reopened all eight final native PNGs after clean hub/feed recapture, comparing the planning sketch; fresh hashes bind those exact inspected files.

observations: Primary agent opened this exact native PNG and the original planning sketch with view_image.
Ivory graph paper, navy pen castle/foliage and eight live assembly cards share the notebook style; HUD and card controls remain legible.
Trees and rocks remain inside the world viewport; zoom changes castle and terrain together, and pan shifts their relative screen positions together.
residuals: The live camera provides a sparse readable battlefield; the concept has denser illustrative scenery and preplaced defence.
At 1024x768 the top HUD wraps into two rows; this intentionally preserves working controls and text size.
